note: Option 1 test (Ian, 18 Nov 23:54): a real public-domain painting as the style reference, Nano Banana 2.1 at 2K.
style: A gothic epic oil painting of 58 BC in the manner of John Martin, Gustave Doré and Jean-Paul Laurens: a vast dark sky, fire and smoke dwarfing the people, deep shadow, grand and tragic, polished old-master finish. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

people.caesar: Julius Caesar, lean, bald crown with thin hair combed forward, clean-shaven, red general's cloak over a bronze muscled cuirass
people.divico: Divico, an aged Helvetian war-leader with long white hair and a long white moustache, gold torc, checked cloak
people.dumnorix: Dumnorix of the Aedui, long fair hair, drooping moustache, gold torc, rich checked cloak
people.divitiacus: Divitiacus, an Aeduan druid with long grey-brown hair and a moustache, white robe, gold torc

beats.text: At dusk the Helvetii leave their homeland for ever: from a high hillside, a long column of covered wagons, oxen and families winds away along a valley road; behind them twelve towns and their granaries burn, a vast column of smoke and glowing embers rising into a dark storm sky. The people are small; the fire and the sky dominate. Gauls with long hair and cloaks, solid-wheeled ox-carts; no Romans in this scene, no churches.
